telecom_replacement.conclusion: By repurposing existing devices (phones/routers) as nodes, the marginal cost approaches zero. The 40-second slice of current revenue ($2.16M) funds the coordination layer, not the hardware. The hardware already exists in people's pockets.
telecom_replacement.strategy: Replace centralized towers with peer-to-peer mesh nodes. Each node is a router + compute unit. No central billing. Agape-based routing.
